mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patrol_task (title, task_type, status, reservoir_name, assignee_id, assignee_name, created_by, due_time, description, warning_record_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{taskType}, #{status}, #{reservoirName}, #{assigneeId}, #{assigneeName}, #{createdBy}, #{dueTime}, #{description}, #{warningRecordId})
mapper.update: UPDATE patrol_task SET title = #{title}, task_type = #{taskType}, status = #{status}, reservoir_name = #{reservoirName}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, assignee_name = #{assigneeName}, due_time = #{dueTime}, description = #{description}, warning_record_id = #{warningRecordId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patrol_task WHERE status = #{status}
